items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: you’re just a sideman. But I’m working for Tim Laughlin, who is a great clarinetist from New Orleans

ctx.x: And who do you take with you?

I’m a sideman on this one, which is great. When you go overseas you don’t have to worry about any of the leader’s problems, you’re just a sideman. But I’m working for Tim Laughlin, who is a great clarinetist from New Orleans, and a protégé of Pete Fountain.
So how do they — he works into his presentation the idea of improvising or ensemble —
